'''Alderaanian Security''' was a security organization that operated on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
One of their agents was sent to investigate [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity in the [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|Deep Core Security Zone]]. For transport back to Alderaan, the agent was frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and sent to [[Sel Zonn Station]]. The Alderaanian Security agent [[Maya]] was sent to recover her frozen colleague, but was attacked on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. However, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were able to collect the frozen agent and deliver it to Alderaan.
